content: Official Cloudflare Python SDK (pip package 'cloudflare', latest 5.5.0) is httpx-based, sync+async clients, auto-retries 429/408/409/5xx, covers zone settings (SSL mode off/flexible/full/strict, TLS 1.3, Always-Use-HTTPS, min TLS version, HSTS) and WAF/firewall resources. Auth via scoped API Token + account ID (preferred over legacy Global API Key). Community wrappers python-cloudflare/pycloudflare are superseded, do not add. Already a pinned backend dependency (cloudflare>=5.4.0); backend/cloudflare_ingest.py already has a mocked stub with cf_account_id/cf_api_token config shape, targeting security_events not cloud_findings.
